evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: To preserve full-token semantics under compression, TBD employs a dual-path teacher-student design, where a full-token teacher provides stable supervision and a compressed student is optimized with task loss, answer-region KL distillation, GT-anchored margin distillation, and reliability-aware KD control.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On LLaVA-Video at retention ratio R = 10 percent, TBD preserves 97.0 percent of the Vanilla model's average accuracy; on LLaVA-OneVision at R = 10 percent, it achieves an average score of 58.4 and matches 100.0 percent relative accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: TBD consistently outperforms compression-only baselines under both moderate and aggressive compression.
